title: Scene document (REST /api/homes/{id}/scenes, stored by the server)
description: A saved look: the state of some outputs in one home. Applying it sends each output a set with src scene:<id>; outputs the person can't control are skipped. Items name an output once. Valves and sensors can't be in a scene (valves only open for a fixed time). The same document is what the AI worker proposes.

room_id.description: Shown with this room; null = the whole home.

fade_ms.description: Fade for every item; absent = the device default.

state.description: The set fields a scene may hold. Fields the output's kind doesn't support are ignored when applied.
